one_line: A seasoned Western Chalukya military chief watching his imperial network fragment under rising Hoysala, Seuna and Kakatiya powers.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic and wiry with a battle-tested build
appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp nose, neatly groomed moustache with light stubble on chin, intense almond-shaped eyes with a thoughtful, slightly weary default expression
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled back into a short, tidy knot at the back of the head; front kept smooth with a narrow, plain gold-copper cloth band circling the forehead like a simple turban strip, no loose strands over the face
appearance.costume: era-accurate Western Chalukya warrior-noble attire: a long-sleeved, thigh-length cotton tunic in muted deep indigo with a subtle woven border, worn under a fitted copper-bronze lamellar cuirass composed of small overlapping rectangular plates; over this, a warm ochre-yellow cotton angavastra draped from the left shoulder across the chest and back, secured neatly and not billowing; lower body covered in full-length, straight-cut off-white cotton trousers with a faint vertical weave, tucked into mid-calf leather boots dyed dark brown; forearms protected by simple bronze bracers, and a narrow fabric girdle in brick-red wrapped around the waist, with one end hanging to mid-thigh; minimal jewellery: a single short gold necklace close to the collarbone and small gold studs in both ears.
appearance.signature: a long, slightly curved Deccan steel sword with a simple disc pommel and straight crossguard, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings and carried at his left hip, right hand often resting on the hilt in a poised, ready stance.

ref_desc: A mid-30s Western Chalukya commander with medium-brown skin, tied-back black hair and a gold-copper headband, wearing an indigo tunic, bronze lamellar cuirass, ochre angavastra, off-white trousers, dark brown boots, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a curved steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a mid-30s Western Chalukya commander from Kalyani: medium-brown Deccan complexion, oval face, sharp nose, neat moustache, thoughtful almond eyes. His black hair is tied back in a short knot, held with a narrow gold-copper cloth band around the forehead. He wears a long-sleeved, thigh-length deep indigo cotton tunic under a fitted bronze-copper lamellar cuirass made of overlapping rectangular plates, with an ochre-yellow cotton angavastra draped from the left shoulder across the chest and back. His legs are fully covered in straight-cut off-white cotton trousers tucked into mid-calf dark brown leather boots, and his forearms bear simple bronze bracers. A brick-red fabric girdle wraps his waist, a short gold necklace rests at the collarbone, and small gold studs adorn his ears. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a long, slightly curved Deccan steel sword with a disc pommel and straight crossguard in a dark brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings; pose him with one hand resting on the hilt, showing deep indigo, ochre yellow, off-white, dark brown, and bronze as the dominant colours.
